facts.business: Malt Land Distilleries Limited (formerly Abhijit Trading Company Limited) operates as a Core Investment Company (CIC) primarily engaged in advancing inter-corporate deposits and making investments, while also borrowing inter-corporate deposits.

auditor.name: V R S K & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision of interest on loans and non-compliance with IND-AS; key audit matters include borrowed loans of Rs. 3,11,820 lacs, advanced loans of Rs. 51,744.55 lacs, and fair valuation of unquoted investments.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Sections 179(3) and 180(1)(c) of Companies Act, 2013 for borrowing without board/shareholder approval
Non-compliance with Section 185 for loans to relatives of directors without member approval
Non-compliance with Section 186 for investment >20% in associate without board/member approval and SEBI LODR disclosure
Independent directors' proficiency certificates not available for verification
Related party transaction of Rs. 4,743,132 without requisite board/member approval under Section 188
Director committee memberships exceed SEBI LODR Regulation 26(1) limits
CSR expenditure not incurred for FY 2025-26 as mandated
Financial statements may not give true and fair view due to non-provision of interest and non-compliance with IND-AS
facts.related_party_note: Related party transaction amounting to Rs. 4,743,132.00 identified without requisite board and member approval under Section 188 of Companies Act, 2013.
